summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K (extraordinary report under Japan's FIEA) disclosing the voting results of its 24th Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders held June 26, 2026. The single proposal was the appointment of fourteen directors, all of whom were elected with approval rates ranging from 75% to 99%. This is a routine governance disclosure with no special-situation elements such as a merger, tender, activist campaign, or strategic review.
